channel.title: Kohinoor Mukherjee — Writing
channel.description: Notes on fintech and on building product.

item.title: Always question what the numerator and the denominator actually mean
item.description: Owning a KPI starts with refusing the definition you were handed, and cutting through the noise around it.

item.title: Users perceive value through design, so good is not good enough
item.description: Hierarchy and clutter are the easy part. Alignment, adjacency and flicker are what people actually feel.

item.title: What to keep upfront, and what to put behind a click
item.description: Let people skip the boring parts quickly. This is not academia — nobody likes reading more than three words.

item.title: Start with the customer problem, then work back to the tech
item.description: A big problem may justify a new vendor contract. A small one doesn't deserve an hour, let alone an AI copilot.

item.title: In a crisis, leadership doesn't want a gap analysis
item.description: They want radical action, a clear problem statement and an impact number.
